authorization: Prepare both datasets and a training plan first; no training or installation of models.

rules.supplement: synthetic train only, never human speaker evidence
rules.gap_fill: qa_passed OR qa_rescued; otherwise excluded from fitting
rules.audio: original WAV bytes, validated mono 16 kHz PCM_16, file and suite-compatible PCM hashes
rules.annotations: existing reviewed offline finite supervision; no ASR invocation; ambiguity excluded from fitting
rules.splits: existing primary speaker split function; every published test/holdout row retained
rules.duplicates: conflicting labels and cross-split file/PCM/speaker/pair identities excluded from fitting
rules.normalization: not fitted yet; future fitting uses only eligible human train
rules.candidate_training: not run; versioned adapter still required

blockers: Fresh independent human wake-command holdout and Pi evidence absent
